event: Determine the speaker's location relative to a robot standing by the sink and facing the dishwasher, when the speech topic is 'announcing location of items'.

sounding_object.description: Man, wearing a turquoise blue short-sleeved polo shirt with a thin black horizontal stripe at the collar and sleeve cuffs, khaki shorts, and glasses. He appears to be of average build. Approx. 1.75-1.85m height. This is the person whose perspective the camera primarily follows.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the double-basin rectangular sink and tap and facing the built-in stainless steel dishwasher, when the speech topic: "announcing location of items" comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the speaker: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
